articles.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
articles.snippet: Jenson becomes the prediction market’s first CFO as Polymarket builds its regulated U.S. exchange and global platform.

articles.title: Crypto exchange giant Bybit to offer European ‘super-app’ with stocks, derivatives
articles.snippet: Bybit has an electronic money institution license in Austria and is about to snag a MiFID license too, CEO Ben Zhou told Coindesk.

articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev fires back at AMC's Aron in escalating fight over stock tokens
articles.snippet: Tenev told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday that public companies shouldn't have veto power over third-party securities that reference their shares.

articles.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
articles.snippet: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.

articles.title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
articles.snippet: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.
